segments.title: How many Americans shop Thanksgiving weekend?
segments.say: How many Americans plan to shop this Thanksgiving weekend? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 183 MILLION!
segments.say: About one hundred eighty three million people!

segments.title: Black Friday is #1
segments.say: Black Friday is the top day. Sixty nine percent of them shop it.

segments.title: Source: NRF survey
segments.say: That's the National Retail Federation's survey.
Follow for Guess It number 28 tomorrow.
